name: gstinapi.in — GSTIN Verification API
description: Look up an Indian GSTIN (GST Identification Number) and get its legal name, trade name, registration status, taxpayer type and registered address, sourced live from India's official GSP network. Free integration: the test GSTIN 00AAAAA0000A1ZT and the test PAN AAAAA0000A answer every GSTIN and PAN endpoint with a sample in the live response shape, never charged; no setup or annual fee. Not affiliated with the Government of India or the GST Network.
